responsibility: This implementation module realizes the `ARRAY OF CHAR` file-output wrapper by measuring a nul-terminated buffer with `StrLib.StrLen` and writing each character through `FIO.WriteChar`, with `WriteLn` delegated to `FIO.WriteLine`. Its responsibility is narrowly to bridge fixed-size Modula-2 character arrays to the core `FIO` file subsystem, distinct from the `String` module’s `DynamicStrings`-based output path.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the ARRAYOFCHAR pair: unlike `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/ARRAYOFCHAR.def`, it provides the executable bridge by computing string length with `StrLib.StrLen` and writing characters through `FIO`.
